criteria.text: verdict-join.sh's machine line carries `"v":3` and a `findings` array under both `--format verdict` and `--format report`. Every existing field keeps its name and meaning.

`findings` holds one entry per finding of each review: lane blockers, notes and dismissed; blind blockers and notes. Each entry is `{src, id, class, path, line, pair}`. `src` is `lane` or `blind`; `class` is `blocker`, `note` or `dismissed`. A missing id, path or line is `null`.

Findings the join matched share one `pair` number, including every blind blocker merged onto one lane blocker. An unmatched finding has `"pair":null`. A blind blocker added to the body also carries `posted_as`, its id in the body.
A lone lane dismissal has an entry, and so does every lane finding when the blind review did not return. The blind `ticket-unavailable` note has none.
The list holds at most 150 entries, and `findings_omitted` counts the rest. A joined verdict of 320 findings stays under 65,536 characters.

A new dev-pipeline tool counts a PR's comments created (reviews: submitted) at or before a given start time. It reads issue comments, inline review comments and non-empty review bodies. It excludes the lane's accounts: `<tracker.bot.app.appName>[bot]` and the login of the gh it reads with. It writes `{at, total, by_author}` to a file. It exits non-zero and writes nothing when any read fails.
verdict-join.sh takes that file through a new flag and emits it as `other_comments`. No flag, an unreadable file or invalid JSON emits `null`, never `0`.
run.sh takes the count at the review's start and passes it to the join. A `run-joined-selftest.sh` case, with another reviewer's inline comment posted before the start, fails without the change.

`/dev-pipeline:review` takes the count at step 2, and `review-lead` at process step 6. Each writes it to a scratch file it never prints, and passes it in its join block. `review-lead` passes the flag only when verdict-join.sh's usage line names it.

Path extraction keeps balanced `[..]`, `[[..]]` and `(..)` segments. `app/users/[id]/page.tsx:12` is read whole, and `[x](src/a.ts:10)` yields `src/a.ts:10`. Two route files at the same line no longer pair.
A joined verdict with the longer line still passes `verdict-check.sh`.
